comments.text:
When it comes to 3rd party games I NEVER think of a console, even tho I have both a Switch and a PS. If I want to play indie games I always buy them on PC thanks to the usually superior performance AND also for most games the possibly endless modding options - and mind you those are usually free mods created by the player community of that certain game for that game specifically - to be able to play the game both visually and on the content aspect modded to my own personal taste (and for that reason I almost never ever get any games on my PS any more either).
- For some games these free mods created for them by the community add more content and more customizing options than an official patch/DLC from the creator of that game - often adding new areas, new quests, new items, new balance-options, more character customizing options and so on and so on...
- None of the consoles offer the same level of community-mod-support as the PC gamer community.
- I got the Switch for Nintendo exclusives only obviously cause they are not available on PC.
comments.author: @IamNotMeButWhoAreYou
